name: Eclipse Rings
description: Concentric rings in a mixed ink palette repeating outward from an off-center point, like ripples on dark water.

code.style: --rule: ( overflow: hidden; position: relative; :after { content: ''; position: absolute; @size: 200%; --pos: @pn(0 100%, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 0); background: repeating-radial-gradient(circle at @var(--pos), transparent 0, transparent @r(5%, 8%), @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)) @lr(), @lp() calc(@lr() + 1px)), @m(5, (radial-gradient(@pn(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)) 50%, transparent 0) @var(--pos) / calc(@n() * 20%) calc(@n() * 20%) no-repeat)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
